correctness.rationale: Transported group algebra product T_lambda(u)T_mu(v) is verified on basis elements, and augmentation is multiplicative. The nilpotent augmentation ideal eliminates nonzero augmentation-zero idempotents. U=1+J is elementary abelian of exponent p; the T_a-stable J-adic filtration and Maschke semisimplicity give exactly fL copies of each character of Fp^×, so each U_j has order q^L. The idempotence equation retains precisely the characters with lambda^j+(1-lambda)^j=1; multiplying their sizes gives 1+q^(L r). The resulting quandle is product of Alexander factors. Direct independent coefficient enumeration in F5 for lambda=2,3 and F7 for lambda=2,4 matches (6,6,8,50); the fixed-field subgroup identity also yields the finite dihedral specialization. These tests are bounded, not proof for all p,d,f.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.
